validation.hoursIncompleteDay: Enter both the opening and closing time, or leave both empty for a closed day.
validation.invalidHours: Check the opening hours. Use HH:MM and make sure the closing time is later than the opening time.
validation.invalidLatitude: Latitude must be between 33 and 43 (South Korea range).
validation.invalidLongitude: Longitude must be between 124 and 132 (South Korea range).
validation.invalidUrl: Please enter a valid URL (e.g. https://example.com).
validation.invalidInstagram: Enter a handle (@username or username) or a valid Instagram URL.
validation.futureVerifiedAt: Verification date cannot be in the future.
validation.invalidPhone: Enter digits, spaces, hyphens, +, or parentheses only (e.g. 02-123-4567).
validation.verificationIncomplete: Please fill in both verification method and date, or leave both empty.
validation.snapshotWithoutVerification: Enter the verification method and date to save the policy snapshot.
validation.policyDetailsInvalid: The detailed conditions could not be saved. Check the preparation, handling, and unconfirmed item entries.
validation.policyDetailsCorrupted: The stored detailed conditions are in an unreadable format, so saving was stopped. Reset them before saving again.
validation.fixFieldErrors: Please fix the errors below before saving.
validation.policyDetailsHandlingMultiNotRequired: A condition with two or more behaviors can only be saved when every behavior is required. Add prohibited, allowed, or conditional behaviors as separate conditions, one at a time.
validation.policyDetailsSpaceDuplicate: The same area and size combination was entered twice. Saving was stopped because there is no way to tell which one is correct. Merge the area exceptions into one.
validation.policyDetailsBehaviorDuplicate: The same situation was entered twice. Each situation can have only one outcome.
validation.policyDetailsAdmissionInconsistent: The admission fee entries do not match. Rates are saved only when the fee is set to paid, and each period and size combination can be entered only once.
